subject: phy
title: Kinematics
syllabus: The frame of reference, motion in a straight line, Position- time graph, speed and velocity; Uniform and non-uniform motion, average speed and instantaneous velocity, uniformly accelerated motion, velocity-time, position-time graph, relations for uniformly accelerated motion, Scalars and Vectors, Vector. Addition and subtraction, scalar and vector products, Unit Vector, Resolution of a Vector. Relative Velocity, Motion in a plane, Projectile Motion, Uniform Circular Motion.

topics.circ: Vectors in a plane & circular motion

body: Distance is the path length; displacement is the straight change of position (can be zero). Average speed = distance/time; average velocity = displacement/time.
v = \f{dx}{dt}, a = \f{dv}{dt} = v\f{dv}{dx}
Graphs: slope of x–t = v; slope of v–t = a; area under v–t = displacement.
Equal distances at v_{1}, v_{2} → average speed \f{2v_{1}v_{2}}{v_{1} + v_{2}}; equal times → \f{v_{1} + v_{2}}{2}.

check.q: Area under a v–t graph gives

body: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at^{2}, v^{2} = u^{2} + 2as, s_{n} = u + \f{a}{2}(2n − 1)
Stopping distance = \f{u^{2}}{2a} (∝ u^{2}: double the speed, four times the distance).
Free fall: a = g downward. Thrown up and down from a tower in t_{1}, t_{2} → dropped takes √{t_{1}t_{2}}.
If x(t) is a polynomial, differentiate: x = t^{3} − 6t^{2} → v = 3t^{2} − 12t, a = 6t − 12.
Horizontal: no acceleration (u cosθ constant). Vertical: a = −g.
T = \f{2u sinθ}{g}, H = \f{u^{2}sin^{2}θ}{2g}, R = \f{u^{2}sin2θ}{g}
Max range at 45°; θ and (90° − θ) give the same range. R = nH ⇔ tanθ = \f{4}{n} (R = H at tan^{−1}4).
Thrown horizontally from height h: t = √{2h/g}, range = u√{2h/g}. Path: y = x tanθ − \f{gx^{2}}{2u^{2}cos^{2}θ}.
v⃗_{AB} = v⃗_{A} − v⃗_{B}
River: least TIME → head straight across (t = d/v_{b}, drift = v_{r}t). Least DRIFT (if v_{b} > v_{r}) → aim upstream at sinθ = v_{r}/v_{b}, t = \f{d}{√{v_{b}^{2} − v_{r}^{2}}}.
Rain: find v⃗_{rain} − v⃗_{man}; tilt the umbrella against that relative velocity.
Ball thrown up inside a moving boat: the ground observer sees the boat's horizontal speed added.

body: ω = \f{2π}{T} = 2πf, v = ωr, a_{c} = \f{v^{2}}{r} = ω^{2}r
Uniform circular motion: speed constant, velocity and acceleration change direction. Non-uniform: add a_{t} = \f{dv}{dt}.
Displacement after angle θ on a circle = 2r sin\f{θ}{2}; distance = rθ.
Under r⃗ → −r⃗: v⃗, p⃗, a⃗ flip but L⃗ = r⃗ × p⃗ does not (an axial vector).

traps: Average speed for equal distances is the harmonic mean, not the simple average.
At the top of a projectile, speed is u cosθ — not zero.
Max range is at 45° only on level ground.
Least time and least drift are different river crossings.
Displacement on a circle uses the chord, not the arc.
Convert km/h to m/s: multiply by 5/18.

steps.note: Graphs and the equations of motion

pyq.q: A particle initially at rest starts moving from reference point x = 0 along x-axis, with velocity v that varies as v = 4√{x} m/s. The acceleration of the particle is ____ m s^{−2}.

A person travelling on a straight line moves with a uniform velocity v_{1} for a distance x and with a uniform velocity v_{2} for the next \f{3}{2}x distance. The average velocity in this motion is \f{50}{7} m/s. If v_{1} is 5 m/s then v_{2} = ____ m/s.

A particle moves along the x-axis and has its displacement x varying with time t according to the equation: x = c_{0}(t^{2} − 2) + c(t − 2)^{2} where c_{0} and c are constants of appropriate dimensions. Then, which of the following statements is correct?
o: the acceleration of the particle is 2(c + c_{0})
the initial velocity of the particle is 4c
the acceleration of the particle is 2c_{0}
the acceleration of the particle is 2c

pyq.q: A bus moving along a straight highway with speed of 72 km/h is brought to halt within 4 s after applying the brakes. The distance travelled by the bus during this time (Assume the retardation is uniform) is ____ m.
sol: 72 km/h = 20 m/s; uniform retardation → average speed 10 m/s.

pyq.q: A body travels 102.5 m in n^{th} second and 115.0 m in (n + 2)^{th} second. The acceleration is :

A body projected vertically upwards with a certain speed from the top of a tower reaches the ground in t_{1}. If it is projected vertically downwards from the same point with the same speed, it reaches the ground in t_{2}. Time required to reach the ground, if it is dropped from the top of the tower, is :
sol: −h = ut_{1} − ½gt_{1}^{2} and h = ut_{2} + ½gt_{2}^{2}; eliminate u → h = ½gt_{1}t_{2}.

pyq.q: A particle moves in a straight line so that its displacement x at any time t is given by x^{2} = 1 + t^{2}. Its acceleration at any time t is x^{−n} where n = ____.

A train starting from rest first accelerates uniformly up to a speed of 80 km/h for time t, then it moves with a constant speed for time 3t. The average speed of the train for this duration of journey will be (in km/h) :

Two cars are travelling towards each other at speed of 20 m s^{−1} each. When the cars are 300 m apart, both the drivers apply brakes and the cars retard at the rate of 2 m s^{−2}. The distance between them when they come to rest is :

A particle moving in a straight line covers half the distance with speed 6 m/s. The other half is covered in two equal time intervals with speeds 9 m/s and 15 m/s respectively. The average speed of the particle during the motion is :

A particle of mass m moves on a straight line with its velocity increasing with distance according to the equation v = α√{x}, where α is a constant. The total work done by all the forces applied on the particle during its displacement from x = 0 to x = d, will be:

A particle starts moving from time t = 0 and its coordinate is given as x(t) = 4t^{3} − 3t. A. The particle returns to its original position (origin) 0.866 units later B. The particle is 1 unit away from origin at its turning point C. Acceleration of the particle is non-negative D. The particle is 0.5 units away from origin at its turning point E. Particle never turns back as acceleration is non-negative. Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
sol: a = 24t ≥ 0 (C ✓), yet it does turn back at t = ½ (E ✗).

pyq.q: The motion of an airplane is represented by velocity-time graph: v rises linearly from 200 m/s at t = 0 to 400 m/s at t = 2 s and then stays at 400 m/s. The distance covered by airplane in the first 30.5 second is ____ km.

The velocity-time graph of an object moving along a straight line rises from 0 to 10 m/s between t = 0 and t = 2 s and then stays at 10 m/s up to t = 4 s. What is the distance covered by the object between t = 0 to t = 4 s ?
A body starts moving from rest with constant acceleration covers displacement S_{1} in first (p − 1) seconds and S_{2} in first p seconds. The displacement S_{1} + S_{2} will be made in time :

A particle is moving in a straight line. The variation of position 'x' as a function of time 't' is given as x = (t^{3} − 6t^{2} + 20t + 15) m. The velocity of the body when its acceleration becomes zero is :

Two cars P and Q are moving on a road in the same direction. Acceleration of car P increases linearly with time whereas car Q moves with a constant acceleration. Both cars cross each other at time t = 0, for the first time. The maximum possible number of crossing(s) (including the crossing at t = 0) is ____.
sol: x_{P} − x_{Q} is a cubic in t (a_{P} ∝ t gives a t^{3} term) that is zero at t = 0.
A cubic has at most 3 real roots → at most 3 crossings.

pyq.q: The displacement and the increase in the velocity of a moving particle in the time interval of t to (t + 1) s are 125 m and 50 m/s, respectively. The distance travelled by the particle in (t + 2)^{th} s is ____ m.
sol: In the next second: v = 150 at its start → s = 150 + 25 = 175 m.

pyq.q: A particle moving in a circle of radius R with uniform speed takes time T to complete one revolution. If this particle is projected with the same speed at an angle θ to the horizontal, the maximum height attained by it is equal to 4R. The angle of projection θ is then given by :
The angle of projection of a particle is measured from the vertical axis as φ and the maximum height reached by the particle is h_{m}. Here h_{m} as function of φ can be presented as
sol: h_{m} = \f{u^{2}cos^{2}φ}{2g}: maximum at φ = 0 with zero slope there (cos^{2} is flat at 0), falling to zero at 90°.
o: falling curve that drops steeply at first and levels off near 90°
falling curve that starts flat (zero slope) at φ = 0 and comes down to zero at 90°
rising then falling hump, zero at both ends

pyq.q: A particle is projected with velocity u so that its horizontal range is three times the maximum height attained by it. The horizontal range of the projectile is given as \f{nu^{2}}{25g}, where value of n is: (Given, 'g' is the acceleration due to gravity.)
The maximum height reached by a projectile is 64 m. If the initial velocity is halved, the new maximum height of the projectile is ____ m.
sol: H ∝ u^{2} → halving u quarters H: 64/4 = 16 m.

pyq.q: Two projectiles are fired from ground with same initial speeds from same point at angles (45° + α) and (45° − α) with horizontal direction. The ratio of their times of flights is
sol: T ∝ sinθ: \f{sin(45° + α)}{sin(45° − α)} = \f{cosα + sinα}{cosα − sinα} = \f{1 + tanα}{1 − tanα}.

pyq.q: A helicopter flying horizontally with a speed of 360 km/h at an altitude of 2 km, drops an object at an instant. The object hits the ground at a point O, 20 s after it is dropped. Displacement of 'O' from the position of helicopter where the object was released is : (use acceleration due to gravity g = 10 m/s^{2} and neglect air resistance)
sol: Horizontal: 100 m/s × 20 s = 2 km; vertical: the 2 km altitude (½ × 10 × 20^{2} = 2000 m ✓).

pyq.q: Two balls with same mass and initial velocity, are projected at different angles in such a way that maximum height reached by first ball is 8 times higher than that of the second ball. T_{1} and T_{2} are the total flying times of first and second ball, respectively, then the ratio of T_{1} and T_{2} is
The angle of projection for a projectile to have same horizontal range and maximum height is :

A body of mass M thrown horizontally with velocity v from the top of the tower of height H touches the ground at a distance of 100 m from the foot of the tower. A body of mass 2M thrown at a velocity \f{v}{2} from the top of the tower of height 4H will touch the ground at a distance of ____ m.

A particle is projected at an angle of 30° from horizontal at a speed of 60 m/s. The height traversed by the particle in the first second is h_{0} and height traversed in the last second, before it reaches the maximum height, is h_{1}. The ratio h_{0} : h_{1} is ____. [Take, g = 10 m/s^{2}]
sol: Last second before the top = first second of a drop from rest: h_{1} = 5 m → 5.

pyq.q: An object of mass 'm' is projected from origin in a vertical xy plane at an angle 45° with the x-axis with an initial velocity v_{0}. The magnitude and direction of the angular momentum of the object with respect to origin, when it reaches at the maximum height, will be [g is acceleration due to gravity]

A ball rolls off the top of a stairway with horizontal velocity u. The steps are 0.1 m high and 0.1 m wide. The minimum velocity u with which that ball just hits the step 5 of the stairway will be √{x} m s^{−1} where x = ____ [use g = 10 m/s^{2}].
sol: To land on step 5 it must just clear the edge of step 4: fall 0.4 m while moving 0.4 m.

pyq.q: Two projectiles are fired with same initial speed from same point on ground at angles of (45° − α) and (45° + α), respectively, with the horizontal direction. The ratio of their maximum heights attained is :
The two projectiles are projected with the same initial velocities at the 15° and 30° with respect to the horizontal. The ratio of their ranges is 1 : x. The value of x is

A projectile is thrown upward at an angle 60° with the horizontal. The speed of the projectile is 20 m/s when its direction of motion is 45° with the horizontal. The initial speed of the projectile is ____ m/s.
sol: The horizontal component never changes: u cos 60° = 20 cos 45°.

pyq.q: Train A is moving along two parallel rail tracks towards north with speed 72 km/h and train B is moving towards south with speed 108 km/h. Velocity of train B with respect to A and velocity of ground with respect to B are (in m s^{−1}) :

A river is flowing from west to east direction with speed of 9 km h^{−1}. If a boat capable of moving at a maximum speed of 27 km h^{−1} in still water, crosses the river in half a minute, while moving with maximum speed at an angle of 150° to direction of river flow, then the width of the river is :
sol: Only the across-river component crosses: 27 sin 150° = 13.5 km/h = 3.75 m/s.

pyq.q: A river of width 200 m is flowing from west to east with a speed of 18 km/h. A boat, moving with speed of 36 km/h in still water, is made to travel one-round trip (bank to bank of the river). Minimum time taken by the boat for this journey and also the displacement along the river bank are ____ and ____ respectively.
sol: Least time: head straight across both ways: 200/10 = 20 s each → 40 s.
Drift 5 m/s × 20 s = 100 m downstream each way → 200 m along the bank.

pyq.q: The maximum speed of a boat in still water is 27 km/h. Now this boat is moving downstream in a river flowing at 9 km/h. A man in the boat throws a ball vertically upwards with speed of 10 m/s. Range of the ball as observed by an observer at rest on the river bank, is ____ cm. (Take g = 10 m/s^{2})
sol: Ground frame: horizontal 36 km/h = 10 m/s; vertical 10 m/s → flight time 2 s.

pyq.q: A sportsman runs around a circular track of radius r (A and B are at the two ends of a diameter) such that he traverses the path ABAB. The distance travelled and displacement, respectively, are
sol: A → B → A → B: three half-circles = 3πr; he ends at B, a diameter away → 2r.

pyq.q: A cyclist starts from the point P (top) of a circular ground of radius 2 km and travels along its circumference (P → Q → R) to the point S (the left end of the horizontal diameter). The displacement of a cyclist is :
sol: P (0, 2) to S (−2, 0): √{2^{2} + 2^{2}} = √{8} km (the path length does not matter).

pyq.q: The co-ordinates of a particle moving in x − y plane are given by : x = 2 + 4t, y = 3t + 8t^{2}. The motion of the particle is :
sol: a = (0, 16) constant; initial velocity (4, 3) is not along a → curved (parabolic) path.
o: uniformly accelerated having motion along a straight line.
uniform motion along a straight line.
uniformly accelerated having motion along a parabolic path.

pyq.q: A man carrying a monkey on his shoulder does cycling smoothly on a circular track of radius 9 m and completes 120 revolutions in 3 minutes. The magnitude of centripetal acceleration of monkey is (in m/s^{2}):
The velocity of a particle is given as v⃗ = −xî + 2yĵ − zk̂ m/s. The magnitude of acceleration at point (1, 2, 4) is ____ m/s^{2}.
When the position vector r⃗ = xî + yĵ + zk̂ changes sign as −r⃗, which one of the following vector will not flip under sign change ?
sol: v, p, a all reverse with r. L = r × p: both factors flip → L does not.

pyq.q: The position vector of a moving body at any instant of time is given as r⃗ = (5t^{2}î − 5tĵ) m. The magnitude and direction of velocity at t = 2 s is,
o: 5√{15} m/s, making an angle of tan^{−1}4 with −ve Y axis
5√{15} m/s, making an angle of tan^{−1}4 with +ve X axis
5√{17} m/s, making an angle of tan^{−1}4 with +ve X axis
5√{17} m/s, making an angle of tan^{−1}4 with −ve Y axis

pyq.q: Position of an ant (S in metres) moving in Y − Z plane is given by S = 2t^{2}ĵ + 5k̂ (where t is in second). The magnitude and direction of velocity of the ant at t = 1 s will be :
sol: v = \f{dS}{dt} = 4t ĵ → 4 m/s along y at t = 1 s (the 5k̂ is constant).

pyq.q: If the radius of curvature of the path of two particles of same mass are in the ratio 3 : 4, then in order to have constant centripetal force, their velocities will be in the ratio of:

A particle is moving in a circle of radius 50 cm in such a way that at any instant the normal and tangential components of its acceleration are equal. If its speed at t = 0 is 4 m/s, the time taken to complete the first revolution will be \f{1}{α}[1 − e^{−2π}] s, where α = ____.

words: Path traced by a moving body
Horizontal distance covered by a projectile
